name: rrdtool-1.x-ddc7ca-blind27
instr:
# rrdtool-1.x: diagnosing injected faults without a test suite

The repository has received 27 separate undocumented edits.

This program keeps series of measurements in fixed-size files on disk and hands them back
as drawings, as machine-readable extracts and as plain figures. It now gets a great deal of
that wrong. Nothing about the stored files changed and nothing about the way it is driven
changed, yet the same invocations that used to be answered correctly are now answered
wrongly, and in several places an invocation that used to do its work stops with an error
instead.

Telling it what to do goes wrong before any measurement is touched. A spelled-out switch
written with its value attached after an equals sign is not understood, and the run stops
saying that switch is unknown. A moment or an offset given as a word is taken for a number
whenever the word begins with one of the first few letters of the alphabet, so such a
moment is refused or lands on the wrong instant, and weighing such a word against the names
the program knows runs off the end of the text, so names that ought to be known can go
unfound and the run gives up saying the moment cannot be read. Naming the
deviation-forecast consolidation function where a consolidation function is expected is
refused as unknown, so archives of that kind cannot be asked for. Feeding an instruction
through the interactive channel rather than as program arguments miscounts the words given,
so the work runs with its arguments shi
